## INPUTS

- time_m_20 NY AM: 20-minute time bars anchored at the first print of the NY AM session (09:30:00 ET on this day); the series order is (session id, known time) over ALL sessions of the row, so the 10 bars before the first NY AM bar are the LAST bars of the earlier sessions of the same trading date (pre-session, London, Asia): they are listed in PRECEDING BARS and in the INPUTS table because the retest look-back (M = 10 bars) and the edge use them.
- Rule: decision time T0 of a bar = the known time of the PREVIOUS bar in the series (whole seconds); line value = the stored 1-minute line at the last minute whose start <= T0 (value known at the START of that minute, back-adjusted high/low converted to raw price, stale limit 120 s); the 8 lines usable in the NY AM window are S_ASIA H/L, S_LONDON H/L, S_PRE H/L and ON H/L (S_NYAM is not known before 12:00 ET and is NaN here).
- Per line: BREAK(up) = close > line (k = 0); break_edge = BREAK(up) and not on the previous bar of the series; LONG retest = break_edge on any of the previous 10 bars and low <= line + 2.5 pts (tol 0.5 x 5.0 pts) and close > line and close >= open; the event is the EDGE of that condition (not true on the previous bar). The signal of the book is the OR of the 8 lines; shorts are computed by the engine but dropped (cell mode long).
- Signal bar = a NY AM bar with part = 0 (the truncated last bucket never signals).
